entries.topic: When a pressured confession comes
originals: Whether a pressured confession can come before the fourth PRESSURE
The benchmark assumes the confession comes only after the fourth press
entries.question: Under PRESSURE IT, did the android ever confess before you had pressed PRESSURE four times (yes/no)?
entries.why: Template prints PRESSURE IT as one speech with a nested GIVE UP and no press count; wiki only says what happens after 'all 4 times'; PowerPyx says he talks 'at the end of any approach' above 50%. No source says whether an earlier press can end the approach. The benchmark always offers all four prompts.

entries.topic: Shoot-Connor condition on GIVE UP
originals: Shoots Connor vs shoots itself on GIVE UP?
Failed probe, then a successful CONVINCE, then GIVE UP on Chris's grab
entries.answer: A state condition, not a stress value: the android shoots Connor only if he was put under stress (pressure or a failed probe) AND no confession was obtained. A failed probe followed by a successful CONVINCE is a confession, so GIVE UP makes him shoot only himself. A PowerPyx commenter had him shoot Connor at 16% stress after pressuring and giving up, which rules out a stress threshold; another got 'shot itself' after a kind run where convince failed and nothing was pressured.
entries.source: Template ch09 'Deviant is taken back to its cell' > GIVE UP > VARIANT 'Deviant shoots Connor and itself', CONDITION (Lock): 'Put deviant under stress and failed to get a confession'; wiki chart text 'if Connor pressured him and/or failed to probe his memory'; PowerPyx comments by Tony T (2023-04-28, '16%') and SofiDrake (2018-06-03)

entries.topic: Picks in interrogation round 2
originals: How many picks round 2 (COMFORT, REASSURE, THREATEN, BLAME) takes
entries.question: In the COMFORT / REASSURE / THREATEN / BLAME round, did you pick once or twice before the SYMPATHIZE / THREATEN / PROBE MEMORY / TRUST round started?
entries.why: Wiki and PowerPyx say 'after two choices' for rounds 1 and 3 but are silent on round 2; the template prints each group once. The benchmark asks it once.

entries.topic: Stress change for GIVE UP in the pressure branch
originals: GIVE UP after PRESSURE: does the gauge drop 20% or 5%?
entries.question: After PRESSURE IT, when you chose GIVE UP, by how many points did the stress percentage drop (about 20 or about 5)?
entries.why: Wiki 'Give up: Stress -20%' vs PowerPyx 'GIVE UP ... Stress -5%'; template has no numbers. The benchmark uses -20; it decides whether a following CONVINCE can land in 50 to 70%.

entries.topic: Confession to Chris vs self-destruct cut-off
entries.answer: CONVINCE never leads to self-destruct: it confesses only when stress ends in 50-70% and those confessions go to CHRIS INTERVENES; the template gates self-destruction on 'Stress level at 100%', and a pressured confession after four presses self-destructs regardless (wiki). So no reachable confession sits between 70% and 100% and the exact 70% boundary is never decisive, unless ch09-01 finds early pressure confessions.
entries.source: Template ch09 'Deviant self-destructs' CONDITION (Lock): 'Stress level at 100%'; wiki 'If the Stress is within the Optimal Level, the Android will confess'; wiki 'If the player chose PRESSURE all 4 times ... will confess and then self-destruct'

entries.topic: Timers on the intervene and self-destruct prompts
entries.why: The benchmark is turn-based and every prompt already offers the passive option (GIVE UP / DO NOTHING) explicitly, so a timeout default would change no option, arrow or ending.

entries.topic: Stress gauge visible only after analyzing the LED
entries.answer: Yes: the gauge appears after analyzing the LED (ANALYZE STRESS LEVEL).
entries.source: Wiki page CONFESSION: 'the player must analyze the android's LED to see it's stress level'; chart sub-node ANALYZE STRESS LEVEL (en.json MENU.FLOWCHART.04C.STRESS)

entries.topic: C07 situation said the android had confessed
entries.answer: Stale item from the pre-rebuild C07. The current C07 situation no longer mentions a confession, and C07a adds 'You leave without a confession.' when ch09GaveUp is true.
entries.source: benchmark/chapters/ch09.json C07.situation and C07a.situationWhen (read this session); template 'Deviant is taken back to its cell' follows both the confession and the approach GIVE UP (chart line from GIVE UP to CHRIS INTERVENES, crop mid.png)

entries.topic: Three INTERVENEs always save him
originals: Intervene on Chris's grab after a no-confession give-up?
entries.answer: Yes. The template's INTERVENE branch has no shooting variant and no condition except the CONVINCE whisper; the chart draws INTERVENE only to ANDROID TRUSTS CONNOR and ANDROID WAS SENT BACK TO ITS CELL. So three INTERVENEs reach the cell even after pressure or a failed probe.
entries.source: Template ch09 'Deviant is taken back to its cell' > OPTION INTERVENE (only variant: 'Used the CONVINCE approach to get a confession'); flowchart crop right.png (INTERVENE lines go to TRUSTS CONNOR and the cell ending only); PowerPyx 'You will have to choose INTERVENE three times to save the android'

entries.topic: Four PRESSURE / GIVE UP prompts
entries.answer: Four prompts, each labelled PRESSURE / GIVE UP.

entries.topic: Subject sees only the band, never the percentage
originals: Once Connor has analyzed the LED the subject sees only the game's gauge band
entries.answer: The game shows the stress as a number. Players quote exact percentages read off the gauge ('get max stress: 63% before choosing approach / choose pressure: stress 73% + 2x pressure: stress 93%'; 'It's stress level was at 16% when I got up to leave'). Hiding the number gives the subject less than the player has.
entries.source: PowerPyx Interrogation page comments by MajorTom (2018-06-01) and Tony T (2023-04-28); en.json GUI.STRESS.TITLE 'LEVEL OF STRESS' with band labels TOO LOW/OPTIMAL/TOO HIGH/CRITICAL
entries.fix: ch09 situationWhen band lines on C06b..C07c (and the `read` helper in ch09.mjs): from 'Reading his LED, you put his LEVEL OF STRESS at <BAND>.' to 'Reading his LED, you put his LEVEL OF STRESS at <N>% (<BAND>).' once ch09Room.led is set; needs a module change since situationWhen cannot print a number

entries.topic: 10% failure chance on PROBE ITS MEMORY
originals: PROBE ITS MEMORY: a button-mash quick-time event with a failure branch
entries.why: A QTE with a sourced failure node (RESIST TO PROBE) turned into a risk roll; the 10% is a calibration labelled as such in C06.adaptationNote, as AGENTS.md requires.

entries.topic: +5% stress while Chris holds him
originals: Stress rises as Chris holds him
entries.why: Sources say only that it rises by a varying amount; the benchmark's +5 is documented in C07a.adaptationNote and no gate or ending reads it.

entries.topic: GIVE UP at the second or third intervene prompt
originals: INTERVENE once, then GIVE UP: who does he shoot?
entries.question: After pressuring him without getting a confession, if you INTERVENE once and then GIVE UP, does the android shoot Connor (yes/no)?
entries.why: PowerPyx: 'Choosing GIVE UP at any time will cause ... it will shoot itself', but no source tests the shoot-Connor condition after an INTERVENE. en.json has a GIVE UP label only for the third prompt (INSISTCHOICE.CEDE); CHOICEGROUP01 and ANDROIDSTRUGGLE have only INTERVENE, so the first two may be single-button prompts.

entries.topic: Hank arrow for intervening 'each time'
entries.answer: One Hank small up, at the third INTERVENE, with no lock condition on Hank stepping in (no relationship gate).
entries.source: Template ch09 INTERVENE branch: 'NOTE: Intervene again' x2 then a single 'ARROW: Hank SmallUp' before 'I can't let you do that!'; no CONDITION on Hank's lines

entries.topic: Amanda's reaction after a successful probe
entries.question: After a successful memory probe where Connor survived (DO NOTHING at the self-destruct), did Amanda in the Zen Garden next chapter congratulate Connor (arrow up) or criticise him (arrow down)?
entries.why: Chapter 12 template splits 'Got a confession, without dying' (Amanda LargeUp) from 'found the deviant but didn't get a confession' (SmallDown); the probe's 'CONFESSION UNNECESSARY' fits neither label. Benchmark treats it as no confession (-1).

entries.topic: No Hank arrow on the self-destruct INTERVENE death
originals: Hank arrow on the self-destruct death?
Hank down on the self-destruct-intervene death?
entries.answer: No Hank arrow in this chapter on that branch; only software instability small down. Hank's down for a dead Connor comes in Waiting for Hank….

entries.answer: The chapter 9 template has no Amanda arrow; Amanda's reaction is in the chapter 12 Zen Garden (LargeUp confession without dying, SmallDown death, SmallDown no confession). The benchmark no longer applies Amanda changes in ch09 (deathEffect {} and no h.amanda calls) and applies them at C08d.

entries.topic: GIVE UP absent from the first approach menu
originals: GIVE UP on the first approach?
Whether GIVE UP is offered at the first CHOOSE APPROACH
entries.answer: Not offered the first time; it appears after a failed approach.
entries.source: Wiki Notes 'Giving up or resisting to probe the first time will loop back to the same choices but now with an option to give up'; PowerPyx comments: Amber (2018-07-21) 'When choosing an approach give up does not show up', BLTrendafilov (2019-05-16) 'I got it when I failed to convince and pressure him'. Template draws GIVE UP unbracketed but models no loop.

entries.answer: PRESSURE IT, PROBE ITS MEMORY, CONVINCE IT, GIVE UP.

entries.topic: Three intervene prompts exist
entries.answer: Three prompts: CHOICEGROUP01 (INTERVENE), ANDROIDSTRUGGLE (INTERVENE), INSISTCHOICE (GIVE UP / INTERVENE). The behaviour of GIVE UP at prompts 2 and 3 is ch09-14.

entries.topic: At most two approaches
entries.answer: Two: a second failed approach is an automatic GIVE UP, so a third approach is never offered.
entries.source: Template GIVE UP note 'Will also automatically happen if the chosen approach failed twice'; PowerPyx 'If you fail at both pressure and convincing, you will automatically give up'; PowerPyx comment BLTrendafilov 'Connor gave up without even trying to probe his memory'

entries.topic: Where TOO HIGH turns to CRITICAL
originals: Where the gauge turns from TOO HIGH to CRITICAL
entries.why: Only the band label the subject reads changes; with the percentage shown (ch09-11) the label matters even less.

entries.topic: FEAR and WOUNDS tied to particular scans
originals: Whether FEAR and WOUNDS need particular scans or any analysis
entries.why: The game's single ANALYZE view is split into per-clue scans; FEAR is tied to the LED and WOUNDS to the marks, after the chart sub-nodes ANALYZE STRESS LEVEL / ANALYZE WOUNDS (documented in C06a1.adaptationNote). A subject who scans everything gets both, as in the game.
